question: For the customer who made a transaction of 634.8 on 2012-08-25, compute their consumption decrease rate from 2012 to 2013. Additionally, identify the client segment that consumed the most in September 2013 and include it in the result.

WITH target_customer AS (
    SELECT "XCL_013" AS customer_id
    FROM "transactions_1k"
    WHERE "XCL_011" = '2012-08-25' AND "XCL_018" = 634.8
),
consumption_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING("XCL_020", 1, 4) = '2012' THEN "XCL_021" ELSE 0 END) AS Cons2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING("XCL_020", 1, 4) = '2013' THEN "XCL_021" ELSE 0 END) AS Cons2013
    FROM "yearmonth"
    WHERE "XCL_019" IN (SELECT customer_id FROM target_customer)
),
top_segment AS (
    SELECT "XCL_002" AS Segment
    FROM "customers"
    INNER JOIN "yearmonth" ON "customers"."XCL_001" = "yearmonth"."XCL_019"
    WHERE "yearmonth"."XCL_020" = '201309'
    GROUP BY "customers"."XCL_002"
    ORDER BY SUM("yearmonth"."XCL_021") DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    CAST(Cons2012 - Cons2013 AS REAL) / Cons2012 AS DecreaseRate,
    Segment
FROM consumption_stats
CROSS JOIN top_segment;

WITH target_customer AS (
    SELECT T2."XCL_013" AS CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k AS T2
    WHERE T2."XCL_018" = 634.8 AND T2."XCL_011" = '2012-08-25'
    LIMIT 1
),
consumption_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(T2."XCL_020",1,4) = '2012' THEN T2."XCL_021" ELSE 0 END) AS Cons2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(T2."XCL_020",1,4) = '2013' THEN T2."XCL_021" ELSE 0 END) AS Cons2013
    FROM customers AS T1
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1."XCL_001" = T2."XCL_019"
    WHERE T1."XCL_001" = (SELECT CustomerID FROM target_customer)
),
top_segment AS (
    SELECT T1."XCL_002" AS Segment
    FROM customers AS T1
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1."XCL_001" = T2."XCL_019"
    WHERE T2."XCL_020" = '201309'
    GROUP BY T1."XCL_002"
    ORDER BY SUM(T2."XCL_021") DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    CAST(Cons2012 - Cons2013 AS REAL) / Cons2012 AS DecreaseRate,
    Segment
FROM consumption_stats
CROSS JOIN top_segment;

    SELECT XCL_013 AS customer_id
    FROM transactions_1k
    WHERE XCL_011 = '2012-08-25' AND XCL_018 = 634.8
),
customer_totals AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.XCL_011 LIKE '2012%' THEN t.XCL_018 ELSE 0 END) AS total_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.XCL_011 LIKE '2013%' THEN t.XCL_018 ELSE 0 END) AS total_2013
    FROM transactions_1k t
    WHERE t.XCL_013 IN (SELECT customer_id FROM target_customer)

    SELECT
        c.XCL_003 AS segment
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN customers c ON t.XCL_013 = c.XCL_001
    WHERE t.XCL_011 LIKE '2013-09%'
    GROUP BY c.XCL_003
    ORDER BY SUM(t.XCL_018) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    (ct.total_2012 - ct.total_2013) / ct.total_2012 AS consumption_decrease_rate,
    ts.segment AS top_segment
FROM customer_totals ct
CROSS JOIN top_segment ts
